measured_against: the standards' own contents, Table A.1 rows and clause-3 headings

sources.why: The framework prints no contents list with page references that this can parse. Its Core is a TABLE of functions and categories; a population read off the extraction would be a count of what was found.
No numbering of any kind: the ids are the guide's own headings. There is nothing to compare a held set against, and the extractor says so in its own output.
Its contents list carries page numbers in a column rather than dot leaders, so this parser cannot read it. A declared population is possible here and has not been built.
